title: Odyssey Systems data-management platforms
summary: Jordan tells of Odyssey Systems data-management platforms, about c. 2008-2010 at unspecified, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: some of the underlying like tech platforms that were being used just in terms of like data management um were Odyssey Systems,

plain: A man who goes by Jordan, who told the podcast host Jesse Michels that a secret UFO program took him in as a child, says that around 2008 to 2010 some of the computer systems the program used to manage its data came from a company called Odyssey Systems. He also mentions MITRE, a nonprofit that does research for the US government. If true, it would tie ordinary government contractors to a hidden UFO effort.
